records.subject: You're in -- let's get Timber Labs set up
records.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Welcome to Wrenfield -- excited to have Timber Labs here. If you get stuck on anything in the first few days, just reply to this email directly and it'll come straight to me.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, zero product activity: no project, no invites, no milestone. Only comm is our own welcome note [email:dcc5dde2]; customer has never replied and filed no tickets, so no evidence of engagement. Team plan implies intent, and 8 days remain, so some self-start chance remains, but silence through day 6 makes it unlikely.

draft.subject: Getting Timber Labs' first project going
draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Following up on my welcome note from last week -- I know launch weeks get busy. Whenever you're ready, the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project; projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them. When you want your team in there, teammates can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, including bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything about your Team plan.

Best,
Chidi
